newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's cenbank offers 25 mln soles of 28-day CDs.
newsitem.headline: Peru's cenbank offers 25 mln soles of 28-day CDs.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru said Wednesday it would accept bids for 28-day Certificates of Deposit worth 25.0 million soles until 1430 local time/1930 GMT BCQY.
All the certificates have an August 29 starting date.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates, which will be announced after the auction, is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
